summary: BIONIC™ Phase 3 Backend Testing Complete - All 4 engines (Sentinel, SIGÉOM, Terrain, Pressure) and consolidated endpoint verified. Multi-level cache (L1: RAM, L2: disk) working correctly with 100% cache hit rate on repeated calls. All 22 pytest tests passed.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/bionic/sentinel/status - Returns active status with capabilities
✅ GET /api/bionic/sentinel/analyze/point - Returns NDVI, EVI, SAVI, NDWI indices with hunting score
✅ Sentinel cache functionality - Second call returns from_cache: true
✅ GET /api/bionic/sigeom/status - Returns active status with layers
✅ GET /api/bionic/sigeom/analyze/point - Returns geological province, surficial deposit, bedrock info
✅ SIGÉOM cache functionality - Second call returns from_cache: true
✅ GET /api/bionic/terrain/status - Returns operational status (NEW engine)
✅ GET /api/bionic/terrain/analyze/point - Returns elevation, slope, aspect, TPI analysis (NEW)
✅ Terrain cache functionality - Second call returns from_cache: true
✅ GET /api/bionic/pressure/status - Returns operational status (NEW engine)
✅ GET /api/bionic/pressure/analyze/point - Returns road/building density, remoteness, hunting impact (NEW)
✅ Pressure analysis for remote area - Higher remoteness score for northern Quebec
✅ Pressure cache functionality - Second call returns from_cache: true
✅ GET /api/bionic/core/analyze/real - Consolidated endpoint returns all 4 modules
✅ Core endpoint selective modules - Can enable/disable individual modules
✅ Core endpoint cache performance - 100% cache hit rate on second call, <100ms response
✅ Core endpoint different species - Works with deer, moose, bear
✅ Cache stats available in status endpoints
✅ Cache hit rate increases with repeated calls
✅ Invalid coordinates return 422 validation error
✅ Missing parameters return 422 validation error
✅ Extreme coordinates (far north/south Quebec) handled correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Cache system well implemented with L1 (RAM) and L2 (disk) levels
All engines return consistent response structure with from_cache flag
Consolidated endpoint efficiently combines all 4 engines with parallel execution
Good error handling for invalid coordinates and missing parameters
seed_data_creation: None - using modeled data based on calibrated datasets (MODIS, geological provinces)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 implementation complete. All 4 BIONIC engines (Sentinel, SIGÉOM, Terrain, Pressure) are operational with multi-level caching. The consolidated endpoint /api/bionic/core/analyze/real combines all engines in a single request. Cache hit rate is 100% on repeated calls with processing time <100ms for cached responses. Data is modeled/calibrated (not live API calls) for vegetation (MODIS-calibrated), geology (geological provinces), terrain (elevation models), and pressure (OSM estimates).

mocked_apis.note: All data is modeled/calibrated from real datasets - MODIS for vegetation, geological provinces for geology, elevation models for terrain, OSM estimates for pressure. No external API calls required for analysis.
